name: Fuente el Fresno (Spain)
description: Vertically divided light blue and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuente el Fresno (an ash tree and a castle).
history: The municipal flag is divided into blue and green with the official arms at the centre; it was approved in 2017, the flag not having been registered officially before.

features.role: Fuente el Fresno arms — ash tree and castle
